_meta.notes: A no-activity period: lines 1, 2, 4 and 6 Column A are all a hand-drawn plain zero (open circle), recorded as 0, and lines 3, 5 and 7 all carry the same balance. Column B repeats the June aggregates unchanged. Neither amendment box is checked. Clerk RECEIVED stamp SEP 15 2014, signed Sept. 13, 2014.

contributions.detail: exact: Schedule A (p3) is printed with 16 ruled rows and ALL of them are empty; its SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE reads 0. Matches stated_c 0 (Summary Page line 1 Column A). Note the same page's TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED line instead carries $38,603.50, which is the AGGREGATE-to-date figure (it equals the Summary Page's Column B, not Column A) - not a period total and not summed here.

expenditures.detail: exact: Schedule B (p4) is printed and entirely empty; its SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE reads 0. Matches stated_e 0. Its TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE line carries $17,806.30, again the aggregate-to-date figure from Column B.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: p3 rows (0) sum to 0 = printed SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE 0 (GATE PASSES); p4 rows (0) sum to 0 = printed SUBTOTAL 0 (GATE PASSES). The TOTAL lines on both pages are deliberately NOT used as gates - the filer put Column-B aggregates there.
itemized.escalation_note: Both schedule pages were additionally pixel-scanned for ink between the rules to rule out faint handwriting; the only marks in the table bodies are the printed rules themselves.
itemized.notes: September 15, 2014 interim (that box is checked; amendment = No), Steven L. DeBry, County Council #5. ZERO itemized lines on either schedule - a real zero-activity period, not an unrecovered itemization: Column A of the Summary Page is 0 on lines 1, 2, 4 and 6, and both schedules' SUBTOTAL cells read 0. This filer is an instance of the documented SLCo pattern where the Schedule TOTAL line and Summary Column B carry the CUMULATIVE campaign-to-date figures ($38,603.50 raised / $17,806.30 spent) while Column A carries the period figures (0/0); the two are not comparable and nothing was summed from the aggregate column. The cover page's street address, phone, fax and email fields are blacked out by the county.
